87:t_1:89.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's an all-out battle, so it's dead simple.」

87:t_1:90.en:
$$マオ$$
「Resistance groups nearby will stage a diversion, and while they do, we break through at a single point.」

87:t_1:91.en:
$$勝平$$
「Breaking straight through the front? Now that's manly!」

87:t_1:92.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This mission is a perfect fit for guys like us.」

87:t_1:93.en:
$$正太郎$$
「And we can't afford to fail.」

87:t_1:94.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's make this a total success and kick those $$サイデリアル$$ guys out!」

87:t_1:96.en:
$$パーラ$$
「$$マオ$$, weren't $$ジャミル$$ and the others in any of the Resistance groups?」

87:t_1:97.en:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry, but we had no information about your friends.」

87:t_1:98.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's fine. Knowing them, they're bound to be fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too.」

87:t_1:99.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If we keep fighting like this, I'm sure we'll meet them again somewhere.」

87:t_1:101.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What's wrong, $$ティファ$$? Is something worrying you?」

87:t_1:107.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$ティファ$$ can sense a little of what's coming in the future.」

87:t_1:108.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then 'poison is closing in'... is a warning about some kind of danger...?」

87:t_1:113.en:
$n
「I'll take your warning seriously. But if we're afraid of it, we can't move forward.」

87:t_1:114.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$n's right! Whatever enemy is waiting for us, we'll beat them for sure!」

87:t_1:116.en:
$n
「That's how it is, everyone. Let's make sure this operation succeeds.」

87:t_1:119.en:
$$アルト$$
「Big talk, $n. Maybe I'll leave next year's Volunteer Club presidency to you.」

87:t_1:120.en:
$n
「No... I'm only who I am because of the Club President. I'm counting on you next term too.」

87:t_1:121.en:
$$甲児$$
「I had my doubts at first, but as Vice President, $n has grown into the leader role pretty well.」

87:t_1:122.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ said that people grow to fit the roles they're given.」

87:t_1:123.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, to improve my command ability, I'll run for Club President next term...」

87:t_1:125.en:
$n
「People have things they're suited for and things they're not.」

87:t_1:126.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Now that the Club President, Vice President and Manager all agree, this discussion is over.」

87:t_1:127.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A huge battle to liberate $$翠の地球$$. Do your best, everyone.」

87:t_1:129.en:
$$マオ$$
「The $$マクロス・クォーター$$ launches in four hours. Make sure each of you has your own machine's final adjustments done by then.」

87:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... What $$ティファ$$ said earlier...」

87:t_1:132.en:
$n
「...I'm done trembling in fear of that anxiety. I'll overcome it.」

87:t_1:133.en:
$n
「Doing that is my fight right now.」

87:t_1:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This coming battle... I have a feeling the anxiety I've felt until now is about to take a concrete form...」

87:t_2:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「As I feared, it's no good. After that man $$バルビエル$$'s attack, the base has stopped functioning completely.」

87:t_2:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「We did succeed in taking the base, but our plan to use the facilities here has gone up in smoke, huh?」

87:t_2:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Now that the main battlefield is shifting from $$翠の地球$$ to $$蒼の地球$$, this base probably no longer means anything to the $$サイデリアル$$.」

87:t_2:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This planet has its limits... is it? It may be connected to the extraction of $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン$$s...」

87:t_2:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So, $$ロラン$$, were you in a Resistance group farther to the east?」

87:t_2:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yeah... That one was built around the $$イングレッサ$$ 《$$ミリシャ$$》, so Miss $$ソシエ$$ and $$メシェー$$ were with me.」

87:t_2:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I came over here to take part in the $$セントラル・ベース$$ assault operation.」

87:t_2:12.en:
$$パーラ$$
「You didn't bring $$ソシエ$$ and the others?」

87:t_2:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
(Looks like there's some kind of situation...)

87:t_2:15.en:
$$パーラ$$
(Yeah... Better not ask right now.)

87:t_2:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「And that's how he ended up joining us on the way.」

87:t_2:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「You knew that $$バルビエル$$ guy, didn't you, Uncle $$ランド$$?」

87:t_2:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「...$$セツコ$$, $$クロウ$$ and I were after him.」

87:t_2:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「You were traveling with $$クロウ$$ and the others?」

87:t_2:20.en:
$$ランド$$
「Until we took $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the north of the Central Continent, yeah.」

87:t_2:21.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I see! I heard that base was also taken by an assault from a small elite force, but...」

87:t_2:22.en:
$$恵子$$
「So that was you, $$ランド$$, and the others.」

87:t_2:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「That said, in that fight we got burned by that $$バルビエル$$.」

87:t_2:25.en:
$$メール$$
「...The truth is, that $$バルビエル$$, $$サルディアス$$ who came to pick him up, and us... we traveled together for a while.」

87:t_2:27.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Does that mean they were spies?」

87:t_2:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「Can't say for sure now. It seemed less like they came just to dig up our information and more like they were keeping watch on what we did.」

87:t_2:29.en:
$$ランド$$
「And at the very last, they showed their true colors and turned on us.」

87:t_2:30.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leaving a huge parting gift behind...」

87:t_2:31.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you're getting that serious, it must have been something really big.」

87:t_2:32.en:
$$ランド$$
「After we took that $$セントラル・ベース$$, $$セツコ$$, $$クロウ$$ and I decided to each go after that guy separately.」

87:t_2:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「Where are $$セツコ$$ and $$クロウ$$ now?」

87:t_2:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Sadly, we haven't heard from either of them.」
